name: Bisaikō
author: prusso
description: A configurable hoverable, pinnable btop popup for the Omarchy bar. Setup: after installing, copy the window rule from this repo's hyprland.lua into your own ~/.config/hypr/hyprland.lua and reload Hyprland -- required for the popup to float and position correctly (see README for details).

barWidget.description: Preview btop on hover, pin it, and configure its placement and timing.
